item.title: San Jose police recover $15,000 in stolen tools from encampment on New Year's Eve
item.description: San Jose police say a New Year's Eve bust at an encampment uncovered $15,000 in stolen tools. Police recovered and returned thousands of dollars of stolen tools to a San Martin plumber and arrested everyone involved.

item.title: Venezuela's government accuses US of attacking civilian, military installations in multiple states
item.description: Explosions and low-flying aircraft were heard early Saturday in Caracas, Venezuela. The government has accused the U.S. of attacking civilian and military sites.

item.title: 'Predator: Badlands' emerges as the highest-grossing entry in the franchise's 38-year history!
item.description: Watch "Predator: Badlands," the highest-grossing entry in the franchise's 38-year history, at home January 6 on digital and February 17 on Blu-ray!

item.title: A timeline of the US military's buildup and strikes against Venezuela leading to Maduro's capture
item.description: U.S. officials tracked Maduro's behavioral habits, including what he ate and where he slept, in preparing to execute an operation that resulted in one of the more stunning regime changes in modern history.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Rain, gusty winds expected overnight
item.description: Going into the evening hours, we can expect scattered showers to develop along with breezy to gusty winds. This will be followed by another round of rain overnight.

item.title: Family of 72-year-old East Bay woman who died in police custody file federal, state lawsuits
item.description: "She is dead because of them. A 72-year-old grandma, never been in trouble with the law." The family of Yolanda Ramirez has filed lawsuits against the Brentwood Police Department after months of trying to get answers on what happened to the East Bay woman who died in October while in custody.

item.title: Seahawks secure No. 1 seed in NFC and division title with dominant 13-3 win over 49ers
item.description: Zach Charbonnet scored on a 27-yard run in the first quarter and Seattle shut down the high-powered San Francisco offense in a 13-3 victory over the 49ers on Saturday night that secured the No. 1 seed for the Seahawks in the NFC playoffs.

item.title: Caribbean holiday travel disrupted, hundreds of flights canceled by Maduro's capture
item.description: Major airlines canceled hundreds of flights across the eastern Caribbean region and warned passengers that the disruptions could continue for days after the Federal Aviation Administration imposed restrictions.

item.title: Venezuela's Maduro now in jail in NYC; Trump says U.S. will run the country
item.description: The aircraft believed to be carrying ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro has touched down at Stewart Airport in Orange County, New York.

item.title: US captures Venezuela's leader and his wife in stunning operation and plans to prosecute them
item.description: Hours after a military operation that plucked Nicolás Maduro from power, Trump said that the U.S. would run Venezuela at least temporarily and tap its oil reserves.
